QueryString.value: SELECT Organization, Project, Version AS Resource, toDateTime(coalesce(ReleasedAt, TargetDate, StartDate, CommitAt), 'UTC') AS ObservedAt, Version, Line, ReleaseKind, WorkItemId, State, toDateTime(StartDate, 'UTC') AS CodeFreeze, toDateTime(TargetDate, 'UTC') AS PlannedRelease, toDateTime(FirstStartDate, 'UTC') AS FirstCodeFreeze, toDateTime(FirstTargetDate, 'UTC') AS FirstPlannedRelease, ScheduleChanges, TagName, toDateTime(ReleasedAt, 'UTC') AS ReleasedAt, toDateTime(CommitAt, 'UTC') AS CommitAt, toDateTime(PushedAt, 'UTC') AS PushedAt, if(PushedAt IS NULL OR ReleasedAt IS NULL, NULL, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(ReleasedAt), toDate(PushedAt)))) AS TagLateDays, multiIf(ReleasedAt IS NOT NULL, 'Released', TargetDate IS NULL, 'NoPlan', toDate(TargetDate) < today(), 'Overdue', 'Planned') AS Status, if(ReleasedAt IS NULL OR TargetDate IS NULL, NULL, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(TargetDate), toDate(ReleasedAt)))) AS DelayDays, if(ReleasedAt IS NULL OR FirstTargetDate IS NULL, NULL, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(FirstTargetDate), toDate(ReleasedAt)))) AS DelayVsFirstPlanDays, if(ReleasedAt IS NOT NULL OR TargetDate IS NULL OR toDate(TargetDate) >= today(), NULL, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(TargetDate), today()))) AS OverdueDays, if(ReleasedAt IS NULL OR StartDate IS NULL, NULL, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(StartDate), toDate(ReleasedAt)))) AS FreezeToReleaseDays, if(ReleasedAt IS NULL OR TargetDate IS NULL, NULL, if(toDate(ReleasedAt) <= toDate(TargetDate), 1, 0)) AS OnTime, multiIf(ReleaseKind = 'Roadmap', 'Roadmap', ReleaseKind = 'GoLive', concat('Go-Live ', arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(splitByChar('.', Version), 1, 2), '.'), '.x'), 'Untracked') AS Stream, if(StartDate IS NULL OR TargetDate IS NULL, NULL, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(StartDate), toDate(TargetDate)))) AS FreezeToPlanDays, if(ReleasedAt IS NULL OR TargetDate IS NULL, NULL, if(toDate(ReleasedAt) > toDate(TargetDate), 1, 0)) AS Late FROM ( SELECT Organization, Project, Version, anyIf(SrcLine, SrcLine != '') AS Line, anyIf(SrcKind, SrcKind != '') AS ReleaseKind, argMaxIf(SrcItem, At, Src = 'S') AS WorkItemId, argMaxIf(SrcState, At, Src = 'S') AS State, argMaxIf(SrcStart, At, Src = 'S') AS StartDate, argMaxIf(SrcTarget, At, Src = 'S') AS TargetDate, argMinIf(SrcStart, At, Src = 'S' AND SrcStart IS NOT NULL) AS FirstStartDate, argMinIf(SrcTarget, At, Src = 'S' AND SrcTarget IS NOT NULL) AS FirstTargetDate, countIf(Src = 'S' AND SrcChange != 'State') AS ScheduleChanges, argMinIf(SrcTag, At, Src = 'T') AS TagName, minIf(At, Src = 'T') AS ReleasedAt, argMinIf(SrcCommit, At, Src = 'T') AS CommitAt, argMinIf(SrcPushed, At, Src = 'T') AS PushedAt FROM ( SELECT 'S' AS Src, Organization, Project, coalesce(Version, '') AS Version, coalesce(Line, '') AS SrcLine, coalesce(ReleaseKind, '') AS SrcKind, WorkItemId AS SrcItem, coalesce(State, '') AS SrcState, toDateTime(StartDate, 'UTC') AS SrcStart, toDateTime(TargetDate, 'UTC') AS SrcTarget, toDateTime(ChangedAt, 'UTC') AS At, coalesce(ChangeKind, '') AS SrcChange, '' AS SrcTag, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(DateTime('UTC'))) AS SrcCommit, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(DateTime('UTC'))) AS SrcPushed FROM ADOTelemetry_ReleaseSchedule FINAL UNION ALL SELECT 'T' AS Src, Organization, Project, coalesce(Version, '') AS Version, coalesce(Line, '') AS SrcLine, '' AS SrcKind, 0 AS SrcItem, '' AS SrcState, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(DateTime('UTC'))) AS SrcStart, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(DateTime('UTC'))) AS SrcTarget, toDateTime(ReleasedAt, 'UTC') AS At, '' AS SrcChange, TagName AS SrcTag, toDateTime(CommitAt, 'UTC') AS SrcCommit, toDateTime(PushedAt, 'UTC') AS SrcPushed FROM ADOTelemetry_ReleaseTag FINAL ) WHERE Version != '' GROUP BY Organization, Project, Version )
